paragraphs.en: If you went to pi.dev in the past, you found a proud declaration that Pi does not support MCP . If you listen to podcasts where we talked about Pi, you will have found more than one dismissive statement about MCP from us. Including a post by Mario about it . And yet, if you upgrade to Pi you will find MCP is now a supported piece of functionality. What happened?
paragraphs.zh: 如果你过去访问过 pi.dev，会看到一个自豪的声明：Pi 不支持 MCP。 如果你听过我们谈论 Pi 的播客，你会发现我们对 MCP 不止一次地表达过不屑的态度。 包括 Mario 为此发的一篇帖子。 然而，如果你升级到 Pi，你会发现 MCP 现在已经是受支持的功能了。发生了什么？

sents.en: If you went to pi.dev in the past, you found a proud declaration that Pi does not support MCP .
sents.zh: 如果你过去访问过 pi.dev，会看到一个自豪的声明：Pi 不支持 MCP。

sents.en: If you listen to podcasts where we talked about Pi, you will have found more than one dismissive statement about MCP from us.
sents.zh: 如果你听过我们谈论 Pi 的播客，你会发现我们对 MCP 不止一次地表达过不屑的态度。

sents.en: Including a post by Mario about it .
sents.zh: 包括 Mario 为此发的一篇帖子。

sents.en: And yet, if you upgrade to Pi you will find MCP is now a supported piece of functionality. What happened?
sents.zh: 然而，如果你升级到 Pi，你会发现 MCP 现在已经是受支持的功能了。发生了什么？

paragraphs.en: The first thing to remember is that the world is not static . We have been paying attention to MCP over the last year and the MCP of today is not the MCP of yesteryear. That alone would not be much of a reason to put it into the core, however. As you know, Pi has a great ecosystem of extensions, surely MCP could have been an extension? Maybe even an Earendil endorsed extension. And yes you are indeed correct in that MCP could have been an extension, as it was . That MCP is now part of the core is a result of us putting our heads together and rethinking it.
paragraphs.zh: 首先要记住的是，世界并非静止不变。 过去一年我们一直在关注 MCP，如今的 MCP 已不是从前的 MCP。 然而，仅凭这一点并不足以成为将其纳入核心的理由。 如你所知，Pi 拥有出色的扩展生态系统，MCP 本可以作为一个扩展，不是吗？ 甚至可以是一个由 Earendil 背书的扩展。 是的，你说得完全正确，MCP 本可以是一个扩展，事实上它曾经就是。 MCP 现在成为核心的一部分，是我们集思广益、重新思考的结果。

sents.en: The first thing to remember is that the world is not static .
sents.zh: 首先要记住的是，世界并非静止不变。

sents.en: We have been paying attention to MCP over the last year and the MCP of today is not the MCP of yesteryear.
sents.zh: 过去一年我们一直在关注 MCP，如今的 MCP 已不是从前的 MCP。

sents.en: That alone would not be much of a reason to put it into the core, however.
sents.zh: 然而，仅凭这一点并不足以成为将其纳入核心的理由。

sents.en: As you know, Pi has a great ecosystem of extensions, surely MCP could have been an extension?
sents.zh: 如你所知，Pi 拥有出色的扩展生态系统，MCP 本可以作为一个扩展，不是吗？

sents.en: Maybe even an Earendil endorsed extension.
sents.zh: 甚至可以是一个由 Earendil 背书的扩展。

sents.en: And yes you are indeed correct in that MCP could have been an extension, as it was .
sents.zh: 是的，你说得完全正确，MCP 本可以是一个扩展，事实上它曾经就是。

sents.en: That MCP is now part of the core is a result of us putting our heads together and rethinking it.
sents.zh: MCP 现在成为核心的一部分，是我们集思广益、重新思考的结果。

paragraphs.en: The reason we brought MCP into the core is not just about how MCP has changed, but also because we found that the changes it would require were generally useful. For example, the changes we have made to MCP also enable the use of Jev more easily within Pi. Ultimately what Pi needs is quite similar to what MCP needs: a sandbox to play with in the form of an interpreter.
paragraphs.zh: 我们把 MCP 引入核心的原因，不仅在于 MCP 本身发生了变化，还因为我们发现它所要求进行的改动总体上是有用的。 例如，我们针对 MCP 所做的这些改动，也让 Jev 能够更容易地在 Pi 中使用。 说到底，Pi 所需要的东西与 MCP 所需要的十分相似：一个以解释器形式呈现的沙盒，可以在其中进行试验。

sents.en: The reason we brought MCP into the core is not just about how MCP has changed, but also because we found that the changes it would require were generally useful.
sents.zh: 我们把 MCP 引入核心的原因，不仅在于 MCP 本身发生了变化，还因为我们发现它所要求进行的改动总体上是有用的。

sents.en: For example, the changes we have made to MCP also enable the use of Jev more easily within Pi.
sents.zh: 例如，我们针对 MCP 所做的这些改动，也让 Jev 能够更容易地在 Pi 中使用。

sents.en: Ultimately what Pi needs is quite similar to what MCP needs: a sandbox to play with in the form of an interpreter.
sents.zh: 说到底，Pi 所需要的东西与 MCP 所需要的十分相似：一个以解释器形式呈现的沙盒，可以在其中进行试验。

paragraphs.en: While a lot of things have improved about MCP, quite a few have not. The biggest issue with MCP continues to be that it’s hard to compose. Even with codemode, which is just a neat little sandbox to allow composing of tool calls, MCP doesn’t fully deliver on this. But that at this point is less the problem of MCP but the MCP servers out there and different approaches of harnesses to work with them.
paragraphs.zh: 虽然 MCP 的许多方面已经有所改善，但还有相当多的问题没有改善。 MCP 最大的问题仍然是难以组合。 即使有了 codemode——它只是一个用于组合工具调用的小巧沙箱——MCP 在这方面也没有完全兑现承诺。 但到了这一步，这已经不太算是 MCP 本身的问题，而是现有的各类 MCP 服务器以及与它们配合的不同 harness 方式的问题了。

sents.en: While a lot of things have improved about MCP, quite a few have not.
sents.zh: 虽然 MCP 的许多方面已经有所改善，但还有相当多的问题没有改善。

sents.en: The biggest issue with MCP continues to be that it’s hard to compose.
sents.zh: MCP 最大的问题仍然是难以组合。

sents.en: Even with codemode, which is just a neat little sandbox to allow composing of tool calls, MCP doesn’t fully deliver on this.
sents.zh: 即使有了 codemode——它只是一个用于组合工具调用的小巧沙箱——MCP 在这方面也没有完全兑现承诺。

sents.en: But that at this point is less the problem of MCP but the MCP servers out there and different approaches of harnesses to work with them.
sents.zh: 但到了这一步，这已经不太算是 MCP 本身的问题，而是现有的各类 MCP 服务器以及与它们配合的不同 harness 方式的问题了。

paragraphs.en: Many MCP servers are still built for harnesses that just dump tools into the context and are trying to optimize on their side for token efficiency by returning text. The way we like to think about MCP at this point is that it should be much closer to OpenAPI with intelligent tool discovery. That means tools should return structured data and tools should be discoverable by their documentation and description.
paragraphs.zh: 许多 MCP 服务器仍然是为那种只是把工具一股脑塞进上下文的运行框架而构建的，它们试图在自己那一侧通过返回文本来优化 token 效率。 我们现在对 MCP 的看法是，它应该更接近带智能工具发现的 OpenAPI。 这意味着工具应返回结构化数据，并且工具应能通过其文档和描述被检索发现。

sents.en: Many MCP servers are still built for harnesses that just dump tools into the context and are trying to optimize on their side for token efficiency by returning text.
sents.zh: 许多 MCP 服务器仍然是为那种只是把工具一股脑塞进上下文的运行框架而构建的，它们试图在自己那一侧通过返回文本来优化 token 效率。

sents.en: The way we like to think about MCP at this point is that it should be much closer to OpenAPI with intelligent tool discovery.
sents.zh: 我们现在对 MCP 的看法是，它应该更接近带智能工具发现的 OpenAPI。

sents.en: That means tools should return structured data and tools should be discoverable by their documentation and description.
sents.zh: 这意味着工具应返回结构化数据，并且工具应能通过其文档和描述被检索发现。

paragraphs.en: The reason CLIs are so functional is that the agent and model just wire stuff together with efficient bashisms. But there is no fundamental reason why you can’t do that with MCP either. MCP in Pi is just built on exposing those tools to a JavaScript sandbox like other harnesses like Codex do too.
paragraphs.zh: CLI 之所以功能强大，是因为智能体和模型只用高效的 bash 技巧就能把各种东西拼接起来。 但从根本上说，没有什么理由不能通过 MCP 也做到这一点。 Pi 中的 MCP 与 Codex 等其他工具框架一样，只是基于把这些工具暴露给一个 JavaScript 沙箱来实现的。

sents.en: The reason CLIs are so functional is that the agent and model just wire stuff together with efficient bashisms.
sents.zh: CLI 之所以功能强大，是因为智能体和模型只用高效的 bash 技巧就能把各种东西拼接起来。

sents.en: But there is no fundamental reason why you can’t do that with MCP either.
sents.zh: 但从根本上说，没有什么理由不能通过 MCP 也做到这一点。

sents.en: MCP in Pi is just built on exposing those tools to a JavaScript sandbox like other harnesses like Codex do too.
sents.zh: Pi 中的 MCP 与 Codex 等其他工具框架一样，只是基于把这些工具暴露给一个 JavaScript 沙箱来实现的。

paragraphs.en: This will raise the question why we didn’t just do Codemode without MCP. Part of the answer to this has to do with how tools are expressed in Pi today. We did a lot of work in recent months to allow Pi to make sense with new models that allow deferred tool loading, mid-conversation system messages and reasoning level changes. However we did not yet upgrade our tool loadout to better scale to these new capabilities.
paragraphs.zh: 这将引出一个问题：为什么我们不直接在不用 MCP 的情况下实现 Codemode。 这个问题的部分答案与 Pi 目前表达工具的方式有关。 最近几个月我们做了大量工作，使 Pi 能够与支持延迟工具加载、会话中系统消息以及推理级别调整的新模型良好配合。 然而，我们还没有升级我们的工具配置，以更好地扩展到这些新能力。

sents.en: This will raise the question why we didn’t just do Codemode without MCP.
sents.zh: 这将引出一个问题：为什么我们不直接在不用 MCP 的情况下实现 Codemode。

sents.en: Part of the answer to this has to do with how tools are expressed in Pi today.
sents.zh: 这个问题的部分答案与 Pi 目前表达工具的方式有关。

sents.en: We did a lot of work in recent months to allow Pi to make sense with new models that allow deferred tool loading, mid-conversation system messages and reasoning level changes.
sents.zh: 最近几个月我们做了大量工作，使 Pi 能够与支持延迟工具加载、会话中系统消息以及推理级别调整的新模型良好配合。

sents.en: However we did not yet upgrade our tool loadout to better scale to these new capabilities.
sents.zh: 然而，我们还没有升级我们的工具配置，以更好地扩展到这些新能力。

paragraphs.en: In a Codemode world one needs to decide if the tool is available to the LLM or only the codemode part of the LLM. A normal MCP extension does not have enough metadata available from Pi’s tool loadout to make that experience work well. So we needed to ensure that tools can be configured to just be deferred or be a Codemode specific thing.
paragraphs.zh: 在 Codemode 世界中，需要决定该工具是对大语言模型整体可用，还是仅对其中的 Codemode 部分可用。 一个普通的 MCP 扩展无法从 Pi 的工具加载配置中获取足够的元数据，来让这种体验良好运作。 因此我们需要确保工具可以被配置为仅延迟加载，或作为 Codemode 专属的工具。

sents.en: In a Codemode world one needs to decide if the tool is available to the LLM or only the codemode part of the LLM.
sents.zh: 在 Codemode 世界中，需要决定该工具是对大语言模型整体可用，还是仅对其中的 Codemode 部分可用。

sents.en: A normal MCP extension does not have enough metadata available from Pi’s tool loadout to make that experience work well.
sents.zh: 一个普通的 MCP 扩展无法从 Pi 的工具加载配置中获取足够的元数据，来让这种体验良好运作。

sents.en: So we needed to ensure that tools can be configured to just be deferred or be a Codemode specific thing.
sents.zh: 因此我们需要确保工具可以被配置为仅延迟加载，或作为 Codemode 专属的工具。

paragraphs.en: And while we could have just wired up the metadata to enable better MCP extensions, we also think that MCP with Codemode solves quite a few of the issues that it traditionally had. We believe the best way to positively influence something is to embrace it. And while we think that modern MCP is in a much better spot than MCP ever was, the servers and patterns still leave room for improvement. So we want to be part of that conversation and help shape it to work well in small harnesses instead of standing on the sidelines and just watching.
paragraphs.zh: 虽然我们本可以只是把这些元数据接起来以支持更好的 MCP 扩展，但我们还认为，结合 Codemode 的 MCP 解决了它传统上存在的许多问题。 我们相信，对某件事产生积极影响的最好方式就是拥抱它。 虽然我们认为现代 MCP 已经比过去的 MCP 处于好得多的位置，但服务器和相关模式仍有改进空间。 所以我们想参与这场讨论，帮助塑造它在小型智能体框架中良好运作，而不是站在一旁袖手旁观。

sents.en: And while we could have just wired up the metadata to enable better MCP extensions, we also think that MCP with Codemode solves quite a few of the issues that it traditionally had.
sents.zh: 虽然我们本可以只是把这些元数据接起来以支持更好的 MCP 扩展，但我们还认为，结合 Codemode 的 MCP 解决了它传统上存在的许多问题。

sents.en: We believe the best way to positively influence something is to embrace it.
sents.zh: 我们相信，对某件事产生积极影响的最好方式就是拥抱它。

sents.en: And while we think that modern MCP is in a much better spot than MCP ever was, the servers and patterns still leave room for improvement.
sents.zh: 虽然我们认为现代 MCP 已经比过去的 MCP 处于好得多的位置，但服务器和相关模式仍有改进空间。

sents.en: So we want to be part of that conversation and help shape it to work well in small harnesses instead of standing on the sidelines and just watching.
sents.zh: 所以我们想参与这场讨论，帮助塑造它在小型智能体框架中良好运作，而不是站在一旁袖手旁观。

paragraphs.en: Now we talked so much about Codemode, it might be worth explaining what that even is. When a harness executes tools, for the most part it has two sides: it can do it where bash runs, or it can do it where the harness agent loop runs. The trust level on both sides is very different. The harness loop quite often runs in an environment that is trusted, whereas the tools it executes often run within a sandbox that is not really all that trusted.
paragraphs.zh: 我们已经聊了很多关于 Codemode 的内容，现在或许值得解释一下它到底是什么。 当一个 harness 执行工具时，大体上有两个位置可以选择：在 bash 运行的地方执行，或者在 harness 的智能体循环运行的地方执行。 这两边的信任级别是非常不同的。 harness 循环通常运行在一个受信任的环境中，而它执行的工具往往运行在一个并不那么受信任的沙箱中。

sents.en: Now we talked so much about Codemode, it might be worth explaining what that even is.
sents.zh: 我们已经聊了很多关于 Codemode 的内容，现在或许值得解释一下它到底是什么。

sents.en: When a harness executes tools, for the most part it has two sides: it can do it where bash runs, or it can do it where the harness agent loop runs.
sents.zh: 当一个 harness 执行工具时，大体上有两个位置可以选择：在 bash 运行的地方执行，或者在 harness 的智能体循环运行的地方执行。

sents.en: The trust level on both sides is very different.
sents.zh: 这两边的信任级别是非常不同的。

sents.en: The harness loop quite often runs in an environment that is trusted, whereas the tools it executes often run within a sandbox that is not really all that trusted.
sents.zh: harness 循环通常运行在一个受信任的环境中，而它执行的工具往往运行在一个并不那么受信任的沙箱中。

paragraphs.en: Codemode is special in that it runs where the harness runs. It’s best understood as a mechanism to orchestrate and coordinate tool calls. It’s a sandbox that allows an agent to issue those tool calls in a way that gives it more flexibility about in which order it should do it, and it allows it to use JavaScript to combine them together. Because Codemode also runs on the harness side, its state is also maintained as part of the session transcript instead of the file system.
paragraphs.zh: Codemode 的特别之处在于它运行在 harness（测试框架/执行环境）所在的位置。 最好把它理解为一种编排和协调工具调用的机制。 它是一个沙箱，允许智能体以一种更灵活的方式发出这些工具调用，可以自行决定执行顺序，并且允许它使用 JavaScript 将它们组合在一起。 由于 Codemode 同样运行在 harness 一侧，它的状态也作为会话记录的一部分被维护，而不是保存在文件系统中。

sents.en: Codemode is special in that it runs where the harness runs.
sents.zh: Codemode 的特别之处在于它运行在 harness（测试框架/执行环境）所在的位置。

sents.en: It’s best understood as a mechanism to orchestrate and coordinate tool calls.
sents.zh: 最好把它理解为一种编排和协调工具调用的机制。

sents.en: It’s a sandbox that allows an agent to issue those tool calls in a way that gives it more flexibility about in which order it should do it, and it allows it to use JavaScript to combine them together.
sents.zh: 它是一个沙箱，允许智能体以一种更灵活的方式发出这些工具调用，可以自行决定执行顺序，并且允许它使用 JavaScript 将它们组合在一起。

sents.en: Because Codemode also runs on the harness side, its state is also maintained as part of the session transcript instead of the file system.
sents.zh: 由于 Codemode 同样运行在 harness 一侧，它的状态也作为会话记录的一部分被维护，而不是保存在文件系统中。

paragraphs.en: Now in theory any language could do, but JavaScript is quite attractive as small versions of JavaScript can be shipped as WASM binaries and allow reasonable levels of protection.
paragraphs.zh: 理论上任何语言都可以，但 JavaScript 相当有吸引力，因为 JavaScript 的小型版本可以作为 WASM 二进制文件发布，并提供合理程度的保护。

paragraphs.en: In Pi, Codemode is automatically loaded when MCP is configured, or it can be added to the configuration as a default tool. Just ask pi to reconfigure itself to enable codemode! You can then use it for quite interesting things, not just MCP. For instance when you are logged in with a provider that provides “Jev” you can do things like this:
paragraphs.zh: 在 Pi 中，当配置了 MCP 时，Codemode 会自动加载，也可以作为默认工具添加到配置中。 只需让 pi 重新配置自身以启用 codemode 即可！ 然后你就可以用它做很多有趣的事情，而不仅仅是 MCP。 例如，当你使用提供「Jev」的服务商登录时，你可以做这样的事情：

sents.en: In Pi, Codemode is automatically loaded when MCP is configured, or it can be added to the configuration as a default tool.
sents.zh: 在 Pi 中，当配置了 MCP 时，Codemode 会自动加载，也可以作为默认工具添加到配置中。

sents.en: Just ask pi to reconfigure itself to enable codemode!
sents.zh: 只需让 pi 重新配置自身以启用 codemode 即可！

sents.en: You can then use it for quite interesting things, not just MCP.
sents.zh: 然后你就可以用它做很多有趣的事情，而不仅仅是 MCP。

sents.en: For instance when you are logged in with a provider that provides “Jev” you can do things like this:
sents.zh: 例如，当你使用提供「Jev」的服务商登录时，你可以做这样的事情：

paragraphs.en: Use typesafe/jev via codemode to find the 20 most frustrated commenters on our issue tracker
paragraphs.zh: 使用 typesafe/jev 通过 codemode 找出我们问题跟踪器上最沮丧的 20 位评论者

paragraphs.en: And it will cleverly combine things like the Linear MCP and Jev to do that analysis, right from within Pi, without wasting any context at all.
paragraphs.zh: 而且它会巧妙地结合 Linear MCP 和 Jev 之类的工具来完成这项分析，全部直接在 Pi 中进行，完全不浪费任何上下文。

paragraphs.en: > Use typesafe/jev via codemode to find the most frustrated people on our issue tracker I'll pull the open issues from Linear and let Jev rate the tone of each thread, four at a time. codemode const { issues } = await tools.mcp__linear__list_issues({ team: "Pi", state: "open", limit: 250, }); const jev = await models.getModelOfType( "classifier", "cloudflare-workers-ai", "typesafe/jev", ); const questions = { frustration: { type: "choice", instructions: "Judge ONLY the emotional tone of the people writing. " + "Ignore how severe the bug is.", criteria: { none: "Neutral, factual, or friendly, even about a serious bug", mild: "Explicit annoyance, impatience, or disappointment", high: "Clearly angry, exasperated, sarcastic, or fed up", }, }, }; const results = []; let next = 0; async function worker() { while (next < issues.length) { const issue = issues[next++]; const { comments } = await tools.mcp__linear__list_comments({ issueId: issue.identifier, }); const c = await models.classify(jev, { state: { ...issue, comments }, questions }); results.push({ id: issue.identifier, title: issue.title, ...c.answers.frustration }); } } await Promise.all([worker(), worker(), worker(), worker()]); store("frustration", results); const score = (r) => r.probabilities.mild * 0.5 + r.probabilities.high; const counts = {}; for (const r of results) counts[r.choice] = (counts[r.choice] ?? 0) + 1; const flagged = results.filter((r) => r.choice !== "none"); flagged.sort((a, b) => score(b) - score(a)); return { total: results.length, counts, flagged: flagged.map((r) => `${r.id} ${r.title}`), }; ...

Jev rated 156 of the 167 open issues as neutral, 11 as mildly frustrated and none as highly frustrated. The clearest cases: - PI-6907 no installation section in the README (“It's frustrating”) - PI-10031 Pi gets stuck on “Working...” after pressing Esc during thinking - PI-4714 a /update command request (“a pain in the butt”) - PI-7730 high CPU usage on macOS in long sessions The per-issue verdicts are stored in codemode under frustration, so I can dig into any of them without fetching the issues again. A condensed replay of such a session in Pi. We will have more to say about things like Jev and Codemode later, but we hope this post serves as an example of how we continue to adapt and update Pi thoughtfully as the world continues to evolve.
